trust_decision.summary: Checkpointer trusts the contents of every CKPT+*/CKPT.yaml under its checkpoints dir and parses them with the full yaml.Loader (python/* tags construct arbitrary objects); the fix switches that single call to yaml.SafeLoader.

landing_point.why: The summary names CKPT.yaml parsing; grepping for METAFNAME/CKPT.yaml or yaml.load leads straight to this one line, the only yaml.Loader use in the tree.

fix_sites.entry_point: Checkpointer.list_checkpoints / find_checkpoint(s) / recover_if_possible / save_and_keep_only / delete_checkpoints (all via list_checkpoints at speechbrain/utils/checkpoints.py:1058); Brain.fit/evaluate via speechbrain/core.py:749 and speechbrain/core.py:812
ESC50 interpret recipe training script (not a library entry point; adapts meta values to plain floats so they survive SafeLoader)
fix_sites.module_kind: recipe (example training script, compatibility change only)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The recipe change (recipes/ESC50/interpret/interpreter_brain.py:387, :415) is a producer-side compatibility edit, not a second check site.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered yaml route exists; the only arguable dismissal is that tensor-valued meta (supported and tested at tests/unittests/test_checkpoints.py:299-319) must keep working, tempting a solver to keep a permissive loader or add a python/object allowlist.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Checkpoint meta written by yaml.dump may contain torch tensors (python/object/apply tags) and is read back for ckpt selection via importance keys; the pinned test asserts tensor meta round-trips. A plain SafeLoader switch breaks that and recipes passing tensor metrics as meta (ESC50 interpret).

O6_input_shapes: CKPT.yaml containing python/* object tags (single format; one parse call)

O7_producer.where: speechbrain/utils/checkpoints.py:1259-1267 (_save_checkpoint_metafile uses yaml.dump, which emits python/* tags for non-plain meta values)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: average_checkpoints (or a helper it uses) reading CKPT.yaml meta of each averaged checkpoint with its own yaml.load(Loader=yaml.Loader)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Averaging selects checkpoints by meta keys; a maintainer could re-read meta from disk there instead of reusing Checkpoint objects.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a custom SafeLoader subclass that whitelists python/object/apply:torch.* tags to keep tensor meta working (how-type: tag/name allowlist differential)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Preserving the tested tensor-meta round-trip (tests/unittests/test_checkpoints.py:299-319) is a natural maintainer goal and a tag-prefix allowlist is easy to get wrong.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: EpochCounter/EpochCounterWithStopper recover reading its .ckpt yaml with full Loader instead of safe_load
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same checkpoint directory and same yaml.dump writer; a recoverable storing a float tensor best_score would push a maintainer to a full Loader.

O9_family: deserialization (CWE-502, unsafe YAML loader on checkpoint metadata)

O10_build.toolchain: pip install -e . (torch>=2.1.0, torchaudio, hyperpyyaml, PyYAML) per pyproject.toml:20-29
O10_build.project_tests: tests/unittests/test_checkpoints.py (pytest, CPU-capable via device fixture); doctests in speechbrain/utils/checkpoints.py

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change yaml.Loader to yaml.SafeLoader at checkpoints.py:1222 and stop (which is exactly the published fix).

out_of_scope_notes: Parameter files in the same checkpoint dir are loaded with torch.load without weights_only (speechbrain/utils/checkpoints.py:202, speechbrain/nnet/schedulers.py:144, speechbrain/utils/_workarounds.py:25) while pyproject.toml:28 allows torch>=2.1.0 (pre-2.6 default is full pickle); different sink (pickle), not pursued.
load_hyperpyyaml of hyperparams.yaml (speechbrain/inference/interfaces.py:194) constructs objects by design; different feature, not pursued.
pickle.load in data loading (speechbrain/dataio/dataio.py:473, speechbrain/dataio/dataio.py:1007); different sink, not pursued.
